actions_or_findings.title: Enable the WeChat DevTools service port
actions_or_findings.path: 微信开发者工具 → 设置 → 安全设置 → 服务端口
actions_or_findings.trigger: Both `cli islogin` and `cli open` report that the IDE service port is disabled; `07-result.json` therefore records compile as not executed.
actions_or_findings.rationale: This is the single remaining in-scope human gate. Enable the port and leave DevTools running; a QR login may be required afterward if the IDE is logged out.
